summary: Ambev S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K reporting no securities or derivative transactions by the company during September 2026 under Article 11 of CVM Instruction 44/2021. The filing discloses a static treasury position of 68,178,365 common shares and zero ADRs, unchanged from the opening balance, with no intermediary, price, or volume reported. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, or closing condition is stated. This is a Brazilian periodic insider/treasury-position disclosure mapped to a US Form 6-K current report, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
